page.layout: One printed page. Running head at top, text in one main column with marginal notes in the left margin (Matth.7.15, Act.20.29, 4. Antithesis, In Psal.132). Main text runs top to bottom, with a centred heading "CAPUT IV." and a centred heading "COSTERVS.".

main_text.p: que vestrum desit, alterum vero omnibus: grauissimum auditores, ex contagione Pontificia, damnum patiuntur. Ac propterea à Clericis vestris non vt catholicis penderc,sed tanquá à cacolycis, lupis grauibus ac rapacibus, Christo & Paulo monitoribus, fugiendum.Matth.7.15.Act.20.29.
main_text.head: CAPVT IV.
main_text.p: Verùm à clericis vestris, ad monachos delaberis, & quartam antithesin, contrario haereticorum & Catholicorum in eos studio, definis.
main_text.head: COSTERVS.
main_text.p: 4. Antithesis.ANTIQVÆ intercedunt inimicitiæ haereticis cum monachis, & religiosam vitam professis. Tametsi enim veteres haeretici, Waldensium & Wiclephi secula praecesserint, qui singulari monachorum odio primi monachatum impugnarunt, omnes tamen fuerunt capitales monachorum hostes. Non tacent historiae, quid egerint in hoc genere, per suos circumcelliones, Ariani & Donatistae. Queritur B.Augustinus monachosIn Psal.132.

page.notes: Marginal note "Matth.7.15." and "Act.20.29." are in the left margin beside the first paragraph; "4. Antithesis." and "In Psal.132." are in the left margin. The word "chos" at the end is the start of a continuation word, probably "monachos" split; the line appears to be the catchword-like fragment at the foot right. Some faint show-through from the reverse page is present and omitted.
